title: Game rules

text.ms: Some rules make the game gentler than real life. Landing grace: for your first {grace_minutes} minutes, nothing runs out. Blackout: if your air runs out, you wake in the shelter and lose nothing. Real low oxygen is dangerous, and your body may not warn you.

source: docs/design/landing-spec.md section 5.3 with the Instructional Designer changes W1 to W7 (section 12). 24 h 40 min in journal.sol, the Earth line and its HS sentence in journal.dome.stable are pending SME confirmation (unverified).
